reason: Downloads HTTP or HTTPS resources as streamed binary files into workspace paths with documented path fencing, timeout, and size limits.

summaries.zh: 将 HTTP 或 HTTPS URL 的二进制资源流式下载并保存为工作区内的文件。
summaries.en: Downloads binary resources from HTTP or HTTPS URLs and saves them as files within the workspace.

capabilities: Fetches files from HTTP and HTTPS URLs
Writes streamed download data to files within the workspace
Can overwrite an existing destination when explicitly requested
